summary: Neil Brosseau, 66, of Denver separated from his hiking party ~2 pm Sunday near the Pyramid Peak summit saddle (~13,000 ft) in the Maroon-Bells-Snowmass Wilderness and did not return; Mountain Rescue Aspen deployed foot teams Monday ~5 am with HAATS helicopter support for ~13 hrs with no result; he was found Tuesday ~3:50 pm alive and in good condition after 48 hrs — he spent Sunday night alone and was helped by hunters Monday night.
location: Pyramid Peak summit saddle (~13,000 ft), Maroon-Bells-Snowmass Wilderness
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; HAATS
notes: 2019-09-15 = Sunday (weekday-verified); incident-start date convention; mined run 809 SnowBrains chunk.
